title: The rig

members.role: the SUPPORT is a catalogued prop, bare in the world - the thing the load will sit on (props from the catalogue only)
it comes down onto its place with its weight (or is stamped) - the rig's ground
the LOAD's place is authored ON TOP of the support's box (s106: the author puts a prop; the fit only advises)
the load appears on the support from a puff, on the word that names it - the risk sitting on its thin support
each part NAMED by its word beside it, one at a time - a name, never a figure (the rig is a metaphor; a number is drawn on its chart)

does: A metaphor carries a load: a support prop lands, the load poofs onto its top, and each part is named in turn - the risk sitting on a thin support, with no figure written on it.
source: Bravos BUB 11:58-12:22 (the elephant on a ball on a tightrope; BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R16). The golden prop-poof proves the poof alone; the rig's proof beat (Steel and Paper H row 17, 'The steel kept building. The paper just got heavier.') waits on the paper prop's approval at P70-HG1
